title: JDBC essentials
description: Practice prepared statements, transaction boundaries and resource handling in a Java database application.

questions.prompt: How should user input be supplied to a PreparedStatement?
options: Concatenate it into the SQL text
Bind it with parameter setter methods
Put it in a SQL comment
questions.explanation: PreparedStatement setter methods bind data to parameter placeholders. User input should not be concatenated into the SQL structure.

questions.prompt: Which call starts manual transaction control on a JDBC Connection?
questions.explanation: Disabling auto-commit lets the application group statements and explicitly call commit() or rollback() on the connection.

options: Advances the cursor and reports whether a row is available
questions.explanation: The cursor begins before the first row. next() advances it and returns true if the new current row exists, or false when there are no more rows.

questions.prompt: Which Java construct closes JDBC resources automatically when its block exits?
questions.explanation: Connection, Statement and ResultSet implement AutoCloseable. try-with-resources invokes close() as the block exits, including exceptional exits.
